name: O365 Mass Sharing Link Creation
description: Detects abnormal mass creation of Microsoft 365 SharePoint or OneDrive sharing links by the same user from the same source IP.
query: event.provider:(SharePoint or OneDrive) and event.action:(SharingLinkCreated or AnonymousLinkCreated or SecureLinkCreated or CompanyLinkCreated or AddedToSharingLink or AddedToSecureLink) and (event.outcome:success or o365.audit.ResultStatus:Succeeded or http.response.status_code:200) and user.email:* and source.ip:* and not source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16) and not url.domain:(organization.sharepoint.com or organization-my.sharepoint.com or *.trusted-partner.example)

query_exception_examples.guidance: These exclusions are embedded directly in the KQL query. Use them only for validated corporate networks, approved tenants, trusted automation or documented business workflows. Avoid excluding broad external domains without SOC approval.

tuning_guidance.starting_threshold: 25 sharing-link events by the same user and source.ip in 10 minutes
raise_threshold_when: Large collaboration teams create many expected links
Migration or automation jobs produce repeated sharing events
lower_threshold_when: Anonymous or external links are included
The user is privileged or belongs to a sensitive department
exclude_when: Internal-only bulk collaboration with a documented business reason
